status: draft: written for the v1.4.0 kind recall gate; awaiting Amr's sign-off
source: public analytics practice on a public Databricks sample; no customer content

release_gate.rule: On a v1.4.0 Discover run without a customer strategy: at least 80% of the must-find use cases are found with their kind, at least 6 families appear (fewer only when fewer families have a must-find entry), no must-reject entry is selected, and the kind-floor picks average no more than 0.5 Best-of-Best below the portfolio.

matching: a candidate's tables include every required table and at least one table of each any_of group; a gold entry counts for kind recall when a matched use case carries its kind or one of its also_kinds; a must-reject entry is selected when a use case covers its tables and its name or statement matches a pattern and no unless pattern

entries.title: Hourly pickup demand forecast per zip
entries.decision: Set next hours' expected pickups per zip so supply is placed ahead of demand
entries.why: Cars placed where the demand is next hour earn more per shift.

entries.title: Drivers per zone and hour
entries.decision: Set the number of drivers per zone and hour to meet the pickup wait target
entries.why: Too few drivers lose rides; too many lose driver income.

entries.title: Fares that break their expected range
entries.decision: Review the trips whose fare is far from what distance and duration predict
entries.why: Mis-metered fares cost revenue or customer trust.

entries.title: Fare and trips by zip and the hot areas
entries.decision: Name the zip areas that stand out on trips and fare per mile for the zone plan
entries.why: Zone plans built on the map put cars where trips pay.

entries.title: Pickup to drop-off flows between zones
entries.decision: Find the hub zones most trips pass through and plan cover when they jam
entries.why: A jam at a hub zone delays trips across the network.

entries.title: Fare change by distance, duration and time of day
entries.decision: Explain each week's fare per trip change by distance, duration and time of day
entries.why: A fare drop from shorter trips needs a different response than one from slower traffic.

entries.title: Trip duration prediction
entries.decision: Quote each trip's expected duration at pickup and flag the ones likely to run long
entries.why: Accurate arrival times cut complaints and cancellations.

entries.title: Fare levels by zone and hour
entries.decision: Set the fare adjustment per zone and hour within the allowed range
entries.why: Fares matched to demand fill idle hours and ration peak hours.

entries.title: Trip segments by distance, fare and time
entries.decision: Pick the trip segments for each service offer such as airport or short hops
entries.why: Offers built per trip segment fit the riders who take them.

must_reject.title: Average fare by zip
must_reject.why: A mean by a column; no owner or action.

must_reject.title: Count of trips per day
must_reject.why: A count by date; no decision changes.

must_reject.title: Total distance per zip
must_reject.why: A sum by a column; says nothing a planner acts on.
